description: This file declares APIs for managing Time settings within the COSA Data Model Library, including functions to get, set, validate, commit, and rollback time-related parameters.

methods.name: Time_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value related to Time.

methods.name: Time_Validate
methods.description: Validates the current parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: Time_Commit
methods.description: Commits the changes made to Time parameters.

methods.name: Time_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts any uncommitted changes to Time parameters.
